data.one_liner: Check if your user has the most recent version of your Flutter app.
data.what_it_does: Checks the local app version against the store version or a centralized API. Can automatically display a platform-specific update dialog with a link to the app store.
use_when: You want to prompt users to update their app when a newer version is available on the App Store or Google Play.
You want to manage app versions and force updates centrally via the Relva API.
avoid_when: You only need basic device info without app update checking.
You are using backend infrastructure that already handles custom forced updates independently.
strengths: Supports both traditional app store lookups and centralized API version management.
Provides customizable dialog options and forced update controls.
weaknesses: Centralized API features (Relva API) are currently in beta with usage limits.
Relva API paid plans depend on manual upgrade requests due to pending payment gateways.
data.setup_notes: No special native permissions required. Optional API key needed if using the Relva API feature.
